description: A terminal gate failure filed its deduped unvalidated bug (VG16): a verify run the loop could not fix, an exhausted verify rework, or a merge refused by a red check. The reactor files ONE bug per subject (a repeat bumps the ledger's count, never a second bug) and emits this event saying a gate went red and where the bug stands. The payload carries ids and enums only — the gate kind, the loop, the run, the PR, the bug — never the reason's text, which is the bug body's job. Terminal only, never a mid-rework red (OD10).
